cities.name: Tampere

liveries.note: Tampere trams: red Škoda/Transtech Artic X34 with a black front. Nysse city buses: white with a blue lower body. Colours estimated from reference photos.

cities.name: Oulu
cities.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (openstreetmap.org/copyright). Building heights from OSM tags or estimated by building type. Elevation: National Land Survey of Finland, Elevation model 2 m, CC BY 4.0, via Mapterhorn terrain tiles (mapterhorn.com). Appearance colours described from reference photographs by zaw-ye-tun, used with permission. Original photographs are not distributed as game assets. Oulu Market Square and Market Hall: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); Estormiz CC0 photographs; original photographs by zaw-ye-tun used with permission. No photo textures distributed. Municipal shell geometry: City of Oulu, CC BY 4.0, tile 212221 (2017); converted, clipped to two buildings and recoloured by worldhood. Appearance: Estormiz CC0 photographs, 2026. Municipal height reference: City of Oulu, CC BY 4.0, tile 212221 (2017), component 226; extracted and converted by worldhood. Oulu Cathedral: OpenStreetMap footprint (ODbL 1.0); 56.5 m tower-height reference from City of Oulu high-rise report (2014). Original geometry interpreted from Leonhard Lenz and Estormiz CC0 photographs; other dimensions and colours estimated.

terrain.source: Elevation: National Land Survey of Finland, Elevation model 2 m, CC BY 4.0, via Mapterhorn terrain tiles (mapterhorn.com).

liveries.note: Pink body, dark glazing, single windscreen and round triple headlights, from a photograph by zaw-ye-tun (February 2026); colours are approximate in winter light. Generic bus body with the operator name as plain lettering; no manufacturer badge or operator logo.
